intro.title: Team Readiness Check
intro.subtitle: Welcome to the team self-evaluation
intro.body_1: This is a quiet space to reflect on how your team really works together. There are no right answers — only an honest read of where things stand today.
intro.body_2: You’ll respond to 28 statements across five dimensions. Take your time; the value is in the pause before you answer.

privacy.title: A NOTE ON PRIVACY
privacy.body: You take this assessment without giving your name or email address. In a facilitated session, your facilitator sees only the team's combined patterns and can't trace any answer back to you.
privacy.toggle_open: Read more about how your data is used
privacy.details_1: We store your answers, the scores and results calculated from them, your completion date, and a technical session identifier in our assessment database on servers in Germany. We keep this data for 180 days. We may use aggregated, anonymized data for analysis and benchmarking.
privacy.details_2: Because the assessment runs without your name, we may need your help to find your submission later. If you contact us about your data, we may ask for your report link or other details that help us locate it.
privacy.details_3: We store the session identifier in your browser's session storage, so the same submission isn't sent twice. It is deleted when you close the tab. We never use browser storage for advertising, analytics, or cross-site tracking.
privacy.details_4: On the results page, you can request the full report by entering your name and email address. This step is optional. We use your contact details to send you the report and to follow up by email about it, and only about it. The colleague who writes to you sees your name and email address, but not your answers or results. You can object to the follow-up at any time, and delete your data using the link in the report email; otherwise we delete it automatically 3 months after your request.
privacy.details_5: Separately, you can opt in to being contacted about related services. We only act on this after you confirm it by email, and you can withdraw it at any time. Q595 GmbH is responsible for this processing. Our privacy policy explains the details and your rights.
privacy.consent: I have read the privacy notice and understand how my responses will be used.

results.subtitle_2: Read it as a starting point for a conversation, not a verdict.

results.quotients_desc_none: Each dimension scored on its own scale. No single primary constraint stands out right now.
results.indices_desc: How the dimensions combine into readiness.
results.critical_sub: Bring these to your team debrief. They matter more than the scores.
results.critical_sent_sub: Your full report, critical questions included, is on its way to your inbox. Open it from the email to view the questions and save the report as a PDF. Nothing there? Check your spam folder.
results.critical_locked_sub: Your profile raises a set of critical questions: the ones worth putting on the table at your next team session. Enter your email and we'll send you the full report with these questions included, ready to save as a PDF.

vitality.description: The collective energy, resilience and sustainability of the team.
vitality.reflection: Think about the team's typical rhythm over the past 3–6 months—not just the last busy week.

emotion.description: The quality of trust, care and emotional honesty within the team.
emotion.reflection: Consider what is consistently true, especially when the team is under pressure.

mind.description: How the team learns, challenges assumptions and makes sense of complexity.
mind.reflection: Think about how decisions are actually made, not how they are intended to be made.

execution.description: The team's ability to coordinate, commit and reliably deliver together.
execution.reflection: Focus on everyday habits and follow-through rather than exceptional moments.

alignment.description: The shared purpose, identity and direction that connect the team.
alignment.reflection: Think about whether purpose genuinely influences daily behaviour and decisions.

resilience.label: Resilience Index
resilience.description: Your team's capacity to absorb pressure and recover.

preparedness.label: Preparedness Index
preparedness.description: Your team's readiness to act, decide, and deliver.

mind.label: Mind Index
mind.description: The cognitive enabler underlying both dimensions.
